title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Benefit Schedule: Jump Start, Lockout, Wheel Change and Winching
content:
## What each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan carries at the roadside

The schedule below states, plan by plan, whether a jump start, a lockout call, a wheel change, the
fitting of the member's own spare and winching a vehicle clear are included, together with the ceiling
on replacing a key lost on a lockout call and the ceiling on one winch recovery.

| Plan | Jump start | Lockout call | Ceiling on replacing a key lost on a lockout call (USD) | Wheel change | Fitting the member's own spare | Winching clear | Ceiling on one winch recovery (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | included | included | 0.00 | included | included | not included | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | included | included | 150.00 | included | included | included | 250.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | included | included | 250.00 | included | included | included | 500.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | not included | included | 300.00 | included | not included | included | 400.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | included | included | 350.00 | included | included | included | 750.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | included | included | 1200.00 | included | included | included | 1500.00 |

### Notes on the schedule

1. A lockout call and a wheel change are included on all six plans.
2. A jump start and the fitting of the member's own spare are included on every plan except Keyturn
   Roadside EV Cover.
3. Winching a vehicle clear is included on every plan except Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, whose
   winch recovery ceiling accordingly stands at USD 0.00.
4. The ceiling on replacing a key lost on a lockout call stands at USD 0.00 on Keyturn Roadside Basic
   Cover and rises through USD 150.00, USD 250.00, USD 300.00 and USD 350.00 to USD 1200.00 on
   Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
